sn37.16:1.1: pañcahi bhikkhave, dhammehi samannāgato mātugāmo kāyassa bhedā parammaraṇā sugatiṃ saggaṃ lokaṃ upapajjati.
sn37.16:1.3: saddho ca hoti, hirimā ca hoti, ottāpī ca hoti, anupanāhī ca hoti, paññavā ca hoti.
sn37.16:1.4: imehi kho bhikkhave, pañcahi dhammehi samannāgato mātugāmo kāyassa bhedā parammaraṇā sugatiṃ saggaṃ lokaṃ upapajjatīti.
